item.title: Arad: Hundreds of Gerrer Hasidim mobilize after false report of draft evader’s arrest
item.description:
The “Tzeva Shachor" alert system sent voice messages to thousands of haredi residents in Arad overnight, warning that authorities were attempting to arrest a haredi draft evader in the city.
Hundreds of Gerrer Hasidim rushed to the scene in response, but it later emerged that no arrest attempt had taken place.

item.title: Zell on Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu: Political deadlock, repeated elections signal weakness
item.description:
Marc Zell, chairman of chairman of Republicans Overseas Israel, commented in an interview with Reshet Bet radio on US President Donald Trump's endorsement of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of the upcoming elections.
Zell attributed Trump's support to the US administration's strategic considerations, saying: "Trump is looking at the interests of the United States regarding Iran and the entire region. Political deadlock and repeated elections send a message of weakness."

item.title: Israeli man shot dead near Ma'ale Adumim
item.description:
An Israeli man in his 60s arrived at the entrance to Ma'ale Adumim from the village of Al-Eizariya suffering from gunshot wounds.
A Magen David Adom team dispatched to the scene examined the man and was forced to pronounce him dead at the scene.

item.title: Trump explains easing sanctions on Russia: I don't want to drive them away from the bargaining table
item.description:
US President Donald Trump addressed his decision to ease sanctions on Russia, which were intended to limit its ability to continue the war in Ukraine, in a post on Truth Social.
Trump described the decision as "very simple," explaining, I am in the process of negotiating Peace in the war between Russia and Ukraine, and don’t want to do anything that will drive, foolishly, Russia away from the bargaining table. Great progress is being made, and that includes current hostage negotiations! Signing that document at this time will do that, and I can sign it later, or any time that I want! Perhaps more importantly, Russia is doing very little, if anything, to help the Islamic Republic of Iran, compared to what they could be doing, and I want to keep it that way, and will, unless stupid people get in the way."
Referring to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Trump claimed that he "doesn't care" about the impact on the diesel market and accused him of being unwilling to end the war. "He doesn’t want to end this war, and probably never did. He could have made a better deal two years ago than he can now. His country is in shambles, a large portion of his land is lost, his oceans and seas are gone, and his male population is low, wounded, and/or dead. I WANT THIS WAR END!"

item.title: Four Canadian soldiers killed, dozens seriously injured in Alberta military base fire
item.description: PM Carney confirms four Canadian service members were killed and dozens seriously injured in a fire at CFB Wainwright in Alberta.

item.title: Ukraine: One killed, two injured in Russian strike on medical facilities in Kyiv
item.description:
At least one person was killed and two others were injured in a Russian strike on Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, the city's mayor announced.
According to the mayor, the buildings hit in the attack were being used as medical facilities.

item.title: HaTzibbur HaCharedi party chairman rejects pressure to withdraw

item.title: Riots and looting in Milan: Over 200 arrested, most of them minors
item.description:
Violent riots erupted in Milan for the second consecutive day amid protests over the rising cost of living. The demonstrations escalated into widespread looting in the city center.
According to media reports, more than 200 people have been arrested, over 80% of them minors. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced that she will convene an emergency meeting tomorrow in response to the unrest.

item.title: Three polls, different results: Likud and Eisenkot battle for first place
item.description: Nine days before Israel's elections, three polls show differing results: Eisenkot leads in Kan 11's survey, while Likud tops the i24NEWS and Channel 14 polls.

item.title: Lufthansa confirms: Bomb threat on flight from Israel to Vienna, plane landed safely
item.description: Lufthansa Group confirmed Sunday evening that a bomb threat had been received concerning an Austrian Airlines aircraft traveling from Tel Aviv to Vienna, Austria. Following the threat, the flight was diverted for an emergency landing in Sofia, Bulgaria's capital.
